name: Рассечение
subject: A silver straight broad sword with simple brass guard, burgundy grip grasped by a silver gauntlet at lower left. Blade extends across frame toward upper right; broad bright white/cyan crescent follows the OUTER CUTTING HALF of the blade in a powerful frontal sideways sweep. Crescent is a partial arc ahead of the hand, never a circle around the handle. Two small dark enemy armor fragments at the far blade-edge impact convey frontal multiple-target knockback. Navy backdrop, silver/cyan/brass/burgundy palette.
caption: Широкий фронтальный взмах меча; частичная дуга следует режущей части клинка.
